chunks: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah (raised the chain) narrated, he said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Wealth that restrains you from injustice is better than poverty that drives you to sin.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ethical difference between wealth and poverty in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a pragmatic ethical framework where the moral utility of wealth outweighs its mere possession, emphasizing that financial stability acts as a safeguard against the compulsion to commit injustice. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that economic conditions are not merely material but are integral to spiritual and moral agency, distinguishing between the burden of poverty that drives one to sin and the responsibility of wealth that should restrain one from oppression.
